title: Runner: a seeded nested item cap, and per-run manifests
description:
Spec first (specs beside the module), then code. The collectors take the amendment's rule: order each cell's items by the seeded hash and answer only the first N (cap 500 items), keeping originals with twins. Existing answer files stay valid; a later larger cap only requests the new items (resumable).

Also generate one manifest per run under docs/kev-runs/<task>.json (same schema and pinned hashes as docs/kev-coverage-first-slice.json, holding only the still-missing cells of that task), and the same for Jev under docs/jev-runs/. `bd replay` must still reproduce studies/ byte for byte.

Depends on the amendment task. Done when a dry run of every manifest reports the capped request counts.
